note: Event page (/event/). Edit this from the dashboard (Content tab, Special event) instead; once saved there, this file is only the fallback. Set "event" to null when nothing is planned. Fields: title, type (subathon | charity | special), start and end (ISO with offset, e.g. 2026-12-12T12:00:00-05:00), description (optional), link (optional, defaults to Twitch), goal (optional: label, current, target, unit like "$" or "subs", url for a donate page), schedule (optional list of { time, title }). The home page shows a callout from 7 days before the start until 3 days after the end.
